**Functional identification:** The 281-amino-acid sequence is **2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridine-2,6-dicarboxylate N-succinyltransferase** (EC **2.3.1.117**). The match to reviewed UniProt entry Q3SN24 is an **exact full-sequence match**, supporting a strong identification.

**Reaction:**

\[
(S)\text{-2,3,4,5-tetrahydrodipicolinate}+\text{succinyl-CoA}+\mathrm{H_2O}
\rightarrow
(S)\text{-2-succinylamino-6-oxoheptanedioate}+\text{CoA}
\]

The enzyme transfers a succinyl group from succinyl-CoA to the substrate’s amino group. It functions in the **succinylase route of L-lysine biosynthesis**, in the pathway toward LL-2,6-diaminopimelate.
